SARGAS_TRAPZORS.Form.Error.ChallengeValu: A challenge "reaches" value must be a whole number of 1 or more.

SARGAS_TRAPZORS.Form.Error.ChallengeBand: Choose a band for the challenge trigger.
SARGAS_TRAPZORS.Form.Error.ChallengeMax: A trap has at most 3 challenge triggers.
SARGAS_TRAPZORS.Form.Error.ChallengeDelt: A challenge change must be a whole number (it may be negative).
SARGAS_TRAPZORS.Challenge.Intro: Link this trap to Victory Counter tracks. A track reaching a condition can fire the trap at the party, and the trap firing, being noticed or being disabled can move a track.
SARGAS_TRAPZORS.Challenge.TriggersHint: Up to 3. A trigger fires once each time its condition becomes true and arms again by itself: "Reaches" fires again only after the track has dropped below the value and risen to it again, a step or band after the track has left it and come back. Choose no track to leave a slot unused. Needs the active GM online.
SARGAS_TRAPZORS.Challenge.EffectsHint: Adjust a track by a whole number, positive or negative. A test fire adjusts nothing. Disabled applies when a hazard ends (End hazard) and from Mark disabled in the Trap Manager.
SARGAS_TRAPZORS.Challenge.TrackNotFound: Track not found. This will not fire or adjust anything until you choose another track.
SARGAS_TRAPZORS.Challenge.TargetNotFound: The chosen step or band no longer exists on this track. This trigger will not fire until you choose another.
SARGAS_TRAPZORS.Challenge.NoteMissing: Victory Counter: the track linked to {trap} was not found, so nothing was adjusted.
SARGAS_TRAPZORS.Challenge.NothingApplied: Nothing to apply: this trap has no disabled effect, or its track was not found.
SARGAS_TRAPZORS.Challenge.NoTargets: {trap} was not fired: there are no party members or player characters to target.
